title: Review-score distribution, overall and by lateness
what_it_shows: Share of orders at each star level; panel B compares on-time/early and late orders within each group
sample: 95,296 orders (88,943 on time or early, 6,353 late)
caveat: Scores are ordinal; group shares are not adjusted for waiting time or review timing

title: Late-delivery rate by customer state
what_it_shows: Share of each state's orders delivered late, with 95% Wilson intervals and order counts
sample: 95,296 orders in 27 states; 6 states have fewer than 500 orders
caveat: Small states have wide intervals; state differs from seller location and distance, which are not shown

title: Low-score share and late rate by dominant product category (n >= 1,000)
what_it_shows: For the 22 categories with at least 1,000 orders: share of 1-2 star reviews and share late, with 95% intervals
sample: 85,423 of 95,296 orders; other categories in p3_state_category_summary.csv
caveat: One label per order (price-dominant category); categories also differ in price, size and seller mix

title: Low-score share by price, freight ratio, items and sellers, split by lateness
what_it_shows: Share of 1-2 star reviews within quintiles of price and freight ratio and within item/seller counts, late vs on time
sample: 95,296 orders; groups with fewer than 300 orders are labelled with n
caveat: Descriptive only; groups overlap with category and distance; multi-seller orders are rare

title: Monthly order volume, late rate and low-score share (Jan 2017 - Aug 2018)
what_it_shows: Orders per purchase month; late share and 1-2 star share with 95% Wilson bands
sample: 95,034 orders from Jan 2017; 2016 (262 orders) in the CSV only
caveat: Months group by purchase date; a busy month (e.g. Black Friday, Nov 2017) may delay deliveries in the next month

title: Waiting time, promised time and delay distributions
what_it_shows: Histograms of wait_days and promised_days (log x) by lateness, and of delay_days for all orders
sample: 95,296 orders; nothing trimmed (panel C pools |delay| > 60 days into the end bins: 113 orders)
caveat: Panel C is timestamp-based: small positive delays on the promised day still count as on time under the calendar rule

title: Review-score composition by delay band (calendar days vs promised date)
what_it_shows: Distribution of 1-5 star reviews within each band of delivery date minus promised date
sample: 95,296 orders; band sizes on the axis
caveat: Late bands are small compared with early ones; delay is tied to waiting time and to review timing (3D)

title: Low-score share by waiting-time band, late vs on time (all orders and after-delivery reviews)
what_it_shows: Share of 1-2 star reviews within weekly waiting-time bands, separately for late and on-time orders
sample: Panel A 95,296 orders; panel B 90,672 reviews answered after delivery
caveat: Few late orders at short waits and few on-time orders at long waits; bands with < 30 orders not drawn

title: Score composition for late/on-time orders reviewed before or after delivery
what_it_shows: Distribution of 1-5 star reviews in the four groups defined by lateness and review timing
sample: 95,296 orders: On t/after 88,769, On t/before 174, Late/after 1,903, Late/before 4,450
caveat: Timing shows when the customer answered, not why; on-time orders answered before delivery are a small group

title: Share of orders with written feedback, by lateness
what_it_shows: Share with a message (has_comment) and with a message or title (has_any_text), all orders and after-delivery reviews
caveat: Writing a comment is a choice; the share says how often people write, not what they write

title: Distribution of message length among orders with a message, by lateness
what_it_shows: Histogram of characters per message for late vs on-time orders; dashed lines are medians
sample: 38,696 orders with a message (missing and whitespace-only messages excluded)
caveat: Lengths stop at 208 characters; 1,984 messages are 190+, suggesting a form limit

title: Most common words in review messages, late vs on time (stopwords removed)
what_it_shows: Union of the 12 most common words in each group; bars show the share of messages containing the word
sample: 38,696 messages with text (34,952 on time or early, 3,744 late)
caveat: Word frequency is not sentiment; accents removed; negation words kept on purpose; Portuguese, untranslated
